fields.statement: Verifier claude-code-04881a3b at 66f5e966f: go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... ok (TestShipChangeBuiltin asserts open-pr-triage and push-merge-triage/land-triage run rhiza ship gate --failed with on.pass gate-fix / gate-fix-merge and no on.fail; open-pr, land, push-merge on.fail route to them; rebase still goes rebase-triage -> rebase-gate-failed -> gate-fix; gate-fix and gate-fix-merge max_visits stay 2). go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestShipGate|TestShipOpenPR|TestShipLand|PrePush' ok, incl. TestShipGateFailedOnPrePushFailure: --failed exits 1 with nothing recorded (a gh/push error records nothing), 0 on the recorded pre-push-failed head, 1 once HEAD moves. Diff read: open-pr and land call shipRecordPrePushFailed only on prePushFailed errors, their responses exit 1 then; both fixer prompts now point at the failing pre-push lines in rhiza run status --json. describe-golden script passes.
